name: Button group
summary: Row of joined buttons where one is active, like a period choice (Day, Week, Month). Built from Button group items.
use: Switch between 2 to 5 views or filters of the same content.
When the choice works straight away, without saving.
avoid: Separate actions next to each other: use separate Buttons with space between them.
Navigation between sections with their own content: use Tabs.
anatomy: Group container with a shared border.
Items: label, optional leading icon. The active item has its own background.
figmaProps: Item: Label, Icon leading, Leading icon
behaviour: Click or Enter/Space makes an item active. There is always exactly one active item.
a11y: role="group" with an aria-label on the group.
Items are buttons with aria-pressed. The active item has aria-pressed="true".
content: Short labels of the same kind: "Day", "Week", "Month".
do: Keep the order logical (small to large, in time order).
dont: Mix items with different kinds of actions.
A Button group without an active default value.
